symptom: On an en_US project with de_DE also enabled, describe microflow prints the concurrency error message in German ('-- also translated into en_US'); drop + create from that output stores the German text under en_US, so the English message is gone. check, exec and mx check are clean; a show message text in the same flow describes and rebuilds correctly
cause: describableMessage (cmd_microflows_show.go) chose the alphabetically first language (de_DE < en_US) instead of the project-default rule every other described text uses (pickTextTranslation, #702)
insight: A describer that picks its own language for one property is a write on the round trip, the same class as #705: exec stores what describe prints in the project default. The existing test passed only because en_US < nl_NL sorts the default first; a language test needs a pair where the default does NOT sort first, plus a control with the default flipped. Grep for any other sort.Strings over Translations keys in a describer
